pr_comments:
> Nice 👍.
> 
> A couple of really minor nits / suggestions, but that is already in a mergeable state :)

Thanks for all of your comments! :) All are valuable :pray:

Thanks. Can you rebase the PR, we just merged a new change that updates the `operationId` generated in the openapi spec, this way the front-end generated code has shorter, more meaningful names instead of the current really long ones that are generated.

Basically you need to use the `AirflowRouter` instead of the `fastapi.APIRouter` (this way the `operationId` is inferred based on the function name of the operation), then regenerate the openapi spec and the frontend code with the pre-commit hooks :)

I think it might also solves the conflicts.
I fixed the conflict and generated files again. Great addition, thanks! Indeed, they were quite long :)

Migrate the 'DELETE' connection to Fast API. 

### Use case/motivation

[AIP-84](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/AIRFLOW/AIP-84+UI+REST+API)

### Related issues

Relates to: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/42370

review_comments: Yes, most of the airflow test suites are 'class' oriented, I think I should rewrite the `test_dags` and `test_datasets` to follow that convention as well for consistency, thanks.
Indeed, I saw more usage on `class` oriented tests. That's why at the final I decided to take class usage. :pray:

```suggestion
) -> None:
```

Not sure, but maybe we can still annotate the return type for consistency

I have already tried adding it in every possible way such as `None`, or any empty response to maybe generalise the approach for handling the NoContent in FastAPI. :cry: 

Adding `None` is not working unfortunately due to FastAPI requirements. FastAPI got angry because even though `None` is a `None`, it tries to see if it has a Body in validation see below error log and of course, it thinks it still has a body in this case in some exceptions since we are passing to check `None`. It gives while running the API. 

Adding any empty response fixed the issue like `JSONResponse(content={})` but then the API is returning 200 rather than 204 because somehow it still thinks we are returning something.
